assert: L1 a pure attacker (no verified success in its scope) is admitted for the first 4 victims only and nothing is ever granted
L2 one verified success lends exactly one unit: the 5th distinct subject is admitted, the 6th and a later credited attempt are refused while the unit is spent
L3 two pre-only reservations are granted and never returned (2 units stay spent), the third is refused
L4 all 50 credited successful attempts are admitted and every unit is returned (0 units held after each outcome)
L5 MEDIUM: the typo holds 1 unit and the same tuple's success returns both (0); LOW: the success returns only its own unit (1 stays spent)
L6 a success on the attacker's own account (same device, IP, UA) returns its own unit only: the victim attempt's unit stays spent

L7 CHARACTERISATION (not a safety claim, F116-01): a replayed success with nothing outstanding returns nothing, but after a new recorded failure a replayed success with NO new successful attempt returns that failure of the SAME tuple (units 1 -> 0); a further replay returns nothing; units never negative
L8 a duplicated failure report spends no second unit
L9 two in-flight attempts of one LOW tuple, one success and one failure, leave exactly 1 unit spent in either order
L10 a success that arrives after the 600 s tuple expired returns nothing: the day tier keeps the unit
L11 a success for a reservation taken in an earlier epoch is never credited into the new epoch (E2 keeps its 1 unit)
L12 the scope day tier admits exactly 6 failing attempts in the day although every epoch still has credit and room
L13 over 7 credited scopes (14 units of scope room) the global tier admits exactly 12 failing attempts in the epoch
L14 5 successful own accounts lend at most 2 units: exactly 2 failing victim attempts are admitted beyond S0
L17/L18 API_OVERUSE and account-less Login make no OAAA store call
L20 the 4th-device request is denied by §5.2 although its spray reservation was granted; the reservation is cancelled at once (0 units held)
L21 a request firing K1 spray (credited, room) and K2 churn (no credit) is refused as a whole and takes no unit on K1 either (no over-spend)
L22 a pre+out failing attempt that fires K2 churn on both commands spends exactly one unit (one grant, paired outcome)
L23 record-only failures firing churn take one unit each (2) and then receive the S0 block decision

L24/L25/L26 CHARACTERISATION (F116-01): tuple-fungible counters are NOT attempt-level idempotent — a replayed success can resolve another pending attempt (L24 ends at 0 instead of 1), a success with no new successful attempt returns a recorded failure (L25 ends at 0 instead of 1), and MEDIUM outcome order changes the result (L26 1 vs 0)
L27 CHARACTERISATION (F116-03): a pre-only route sharing a scope with credited pre+out traffic is NOT S0: it is admitted 2 times where S0 denies, and the units stay spent (never resolved)
